    and take delight in my people;
  the sound of weeping and of crying
    will be heard in it no more.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
“Never again will there be in it
    an infant who lives but a few days,
    or an old man who does not live out his years;
  the one who dies at a hundred
    will be thought a mere child;
  the one who fails to reach a hundred
    will be considered accursed.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation
Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
Before they call I will answer;
    while they are still speaking I will hear.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
This is what the Lord says:
  “Heaven is my throne,
    and the earth is my footstool.
  Where is the house you will build for me?
    Where will my resting place be?

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
Has not my hand made all these things,
    and so they came into being?”
    declares the Lord.
    
  “These are the ones I look on with favor:
    those who are humble and contrite in spirit,
    and who tremble at my word.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
Hear the word of the Lord,
    you who tremble at his word:
  “Your own people who hate you,
    and exclude you because of my name, have said,
  ‘Let the Lord be glorified,
    that we may see your joy!’
    Yet they will be put to shame.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
“Rejoice with Jerusalem and be glad for her,
    all you who love her;
  rejoice greatly with her,
    all you who mourn over her.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
For you will nurse and be satisfied
    at her comforting breasts;
  you will drink deeply
    and delight in her overflowing abundance.”

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: “Those who consecrate and purify themselves to go into the gardens, following one who is among those who eat the flesh of pigs, rats and other unclean things—they will meet their end together with the one they follow,” declares the Lord.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
so I also will choose harsh treatment for them
    and will bring on them what they dread.
  For when I called, no one answered,
    when I spoke, no one listened.
  They did evil in my sight
    and chose what displeases me.”

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
For with fire and with his sword
    the Lord will execute judgment on all people,
    and many will be those slain by the Lord.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: “And I, because of what they have planned and done, am about to come and gather the people of all nations and languages, and they will come and see my glory.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: “I will set a sign among them, and I will send some of those who survive to the nations—to Tarshish, to the Libyans and Lydians (famous as archers), to Tubal and Greece, and to the distant islands that have not heard of my fame or seen my glory. They will proclaim my glory among the nations.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: And they will bring all your people, from all the nations, to my holy mountain in Jerusalem as an offering to the Lord—on horses, in chariots and wagons, and on mules and camels,” says the Lord. “They will bring them, as the Israelites bring their grain offerings, to the temple of the Lord in ceremonially clean vessels.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: “As the new heavens and the new earth that I make will endure before me,” declares the Lord, “so will your name and descendants endure.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: From one New Moon to another and from one Sabbath to another, all mankind will come and bow down before me,” says the Lord.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
Hear that uproar from the city,
    hear that noise from the temple!
  It is the sound of the Lord
    repaying his enemies all they deserve.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
Who has ever heard of such things?
    Who has ever seen things like this?
  Can a country be born in a day
    or a nation be brought forth in a moment?
  Yet no sooner is Zion in labor
    than she gives birth to her children.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
For this is what the Lord says:
  “I will extend peace to her like a river,
    and the wealth of nations like a flooding stream;
  you will nurse and be carried on her arm
    and dandled on her knees.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
See, the Lord is coming with fire,
    and his chariots are like a whirlwind;
  he will bring down his anger with fury,
    and his rebuke with flames of fire.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: And I will select some of them also to be priests and Levites,” says the Lord.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
But whoever sacrifices a bull
    is like one who kills a person,
  and whoever offers a lamb
    is like one who breaks a dog’s neck;
  whoever makes a grain offering
    is like one who presents pig’s blood,
  and whoever burns memorial incense
    is like one who worships an idol.
  They have chosen their own ways,
    and they delight in their abominations;

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
“Before she goes into labor,
    she gives birth;
  before the pains come upon her,
    she delivers a son.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
Do I bring to the moment of birth
    and not give delivery?”
    says the Lord.
  “Do I close up the womb
    when I bring to delivery?”
    says your God.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation
Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content:
When you see this, your heart will rejoice
    and you will flourish like grass;
  the hand of the Lord will be made known to his servants,
    but his fury will be shown to his foes.

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: “And they will go out and look on the dead bodies of those who rebelled against me; the worms that eat them will not die, the fire that burns them will not be quenched, and they will be loathsome to all mankind.”

teaching.name: Redeemer's reason for rejecting the nation

content: Say to him, ‘Be careful, keep calm and don’t be afraid. Do not lose heart because of these two smoldering stubs of firewood—because of the fierce anger of Rezin and Aram and of the son of Remaliah.
“Let us invade Judah; let us tear it apart and divide it among ourselves, and make the son of Tabeel king over it.”

for the head of Aram is Damascus,
    and the head of Damascus is only Rezin.
  Within sixty-five years
    Ephraim will be too shattered to be a people.
“Ask the Lord your God for a sign, whether in the deepest depths or in the highest heights.”
In that day the Lord will whistle for flies from the Nile delta in Egypt and for bees from the land of Assyria.
Now the house of David was told, “Aram has allied itself with Ephraim”; so the hearts of Ahaz and his people were shaken, as the trees of the forest are shaken by the wind.
Aram, Ephraim and Remaliah’s son have plotted your ruin, saying,

The head of Ephraim is Samaria,
    and the head of Samaria is only Remaliah’s son.
  If you do not stand firm in your faith,
    you will not stand at all.’ ”
But Ahaz said, “I will not ask; I will not put the Lord to the test.”
The Lord will bring on you and on your people and on the house of your father a time unlike any since Ephraim broke away from Judah—he will bring the king of Assyria.”
In that day, a person will keep alive a young cow and two goats.
And because of the abundance of the milk they give, there will be curds to eat. All who remain in the land will eat curds and honey.
When Ahaz son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, was king of Judah, King Rezin of Aram and Pekah son of Remaliah king of Israel marched up to fight against Jerusalem, but they could not overpower it.
Then the Lord said to Isaiah, “Go out, you and your son Shear-Jashub, to meet Ahaz at the end of the aqueduct of the Upper Pool, on the road to the Launderer’s Field.

Yet this is what the Sovereign Lord says:
  “ ‘It will not take place,
    it will not happen,
Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and will call him Immanuel.
He will be eating curds and honey when he knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right,
They will all come and settle in the steep ravines and in the crevices in the rocks, on all the thornbushes and at all the water holes.
Hunters will go there with bow and arrow, for the land will be covered with briers and thorns.
Again the Lord spoke to Ahaz,
Then Isaiah said, “Hear now, you house of David! Is it not enough to try the patience of humans? Will you try the patience of my God also?
for before the boy knows enough to reject the wrong and choose the right, the land of the two kings you dread will be laid waste.
In that day the Lord will use a razor hired from beyond the Euphrates River—the king of Assyria—to shave your heads and private parts, and to cut off your beards also.
In that day, in every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, there will be only briers and thorns.
As for all the hills once cultivated by the hoe, you will no longer go there for fear of the briers and thorns; they will become places where cattle are turned loose and where sheep run.

“Because this people has rejected
    the gently flowing waters of Shiloah
  and rejoices over Rezin
    and the son of Remaliah,

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
and sweep on into Judah, swirling over it,
    passing through it and reaching up to the neck.
  Its outspread wings will cover the breadth of your land,
    Immanuel!”

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son
Birth of the prophet's second son

content: For before the boy knows how to say ‘My father’ or ‘My mother,’ the wealth of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried off by the king of Assyria.”

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: The Lord spoke to me again:

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
therefore the Lord is about to bring against them
    the mighty floodwaters of the Euphrates—
    the king of Assyria with all his pomp.
  It will overflow all its channels,
    run over all its banks

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
Raise the war cry, you nations, and be shattered!
    Listen, all you distant lands.
  Prepare for battle, and be shattered!
    Prepare for battle, and be shattered!

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
The Lord Almighty is the one you are to regard as holy,
    he is the one you are to fear,
    he is the one you are to dread.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son
Birth of the prophet's second son

content: When someone tells you to consult mediums and spiritists, who whisper and mutter, should not a people inquire of their God? Why consult the dead on behalf of the living?

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: Distressed and hungry, they will roam through the land; when they are famished, they will become enraged and, looking upward, will curse their king and their God.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: Then they will look toward the earth and see only distress and darkness and fearful gloom, and they will be thrust into utter darkness.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: The Lord said to me, “Take a large scroll and write on it with an ordinary pen: Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.”

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: So I called in Uriah the priest and Zechariah son of Jeberekiah as reliable witnesses for me.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: This is what the Lord says to me with his strong hand upon me, warning me not to follow the way of this people:

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
I will wait for the Lord,
    who is hiding his face from the descendants of Jacob.
  I will put my trust in him.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: Then I made love to the prophetess, and she conceived and gave birth to a son. And the Lord said to me, “Name him Maher-Shalal-Hash-Baz.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
“Do not call conspiracy
    everything this people calls a conspiracy;
  do not fear what they fear,
    and do not dread it.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
He will be a holy place;
    for both Israel and Judah he will be
  a stone that causes people to stumble
    and a rock that makes them fall.
  And for the people of Jerusalem he will be
    a trap and a snare.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content:
Bind up this testimony of warning
    and seal up God’s instruction among my disciples.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: Here am I, and the children the Lord has given me. We are signs and symbols in Israel from the Lord Almighty, who dwells on Mount Zion.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: Consult God’s instruction and the testimony of warning. If anyone does not speak according to this word, they have no light of dawn.

teaching.name: Birth of the prophet's second son

content: Nevertheless, there will be no more gloom for those who were in distress. In the past he humbled the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali, but in the future he will honor Galilee of the nations, by the Way of the Sea, beyond the Jordan—

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
But the Lord has strengthened Rezin’s foes against them
    and has spurred their enemies on.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Surely wickedness burns like a fire;
    it consumes briers and thorns,
  it sets the forest thickets ablaze,
    so that it rolls upward in a column of smoke.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
By the wrath of the Lord Almighty
    the land will be scorched
  and the people will be fuel for the fire;
    they will not spare one another.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Manasseh will feed on Ephraim, and Ephraim on Manasseh;
    together they will turn against Judah.
    
  Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
For as in the day of Midian’s defeat,
    you have shattered
  the yoke that burdens them,
    the bar across their shoulders,
    the rod of their oppressor.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Of the greatness of his government and peace
    there will be no end.
  He will reign on David’s throne
    and over his kingdom,
  establishing and upholding it
    with justice and righteousness
    from that time on and forever.
  The zeal of the Lord Almighty
    will accomplish this.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
The Lord has sent a message against Jacob;
    it will fall on Israel.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
So the Lord will cut off from Israel both head and tail,
    both palm branch and reed in a single day;

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Therefore the Lord will take no pleasure in the young men,
    nor will he pity the fatherless and widows,
  for everyone is ungodly and wicked,
    every mouth speaks folly.
    
  Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
On the right they will devour,
    but still be hungry;
  on the left they will eat,
    but not be satisfied.
  Each will feed on the flesh of their own offspring:

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Every warrior’s boot used in battle
    and every garment rolled in blood
  will be destined for burning,
    will be fuel for the fire.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
All the people will know it—
    Ephraim and the inhabitants of Samaria—
  who say with pride
    and arrogance of heart,

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Arameans from the east and Philistines from the west
    have devoured Israel with open mouth.
    
  Yet for all this, his anger is not turned away,
    his hand is still upraised.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
Those who guide this people mislead them,
    and those who are guided are led astray.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
The people walking in darkness
    have seen a great light;
  on those living in the land of deep darkness
    a light has dawned.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
You have enlarged the nation
    and increased their joy;
  they rejoice before you
    as people rejoice at the harvest,
  as warriors rejoice
    when dividing the plunder.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
For to us a child is born,
    to us a son is given,
    and the government will be on his shoulders.
  And he will be called
    Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God,
    Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
“The bricks have fallen down,
    but we will rebuild with dressed stone;
  the fig trees have been felled,
    but we will replace them with cedars.”

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
But the people have not returned to him who struck them,
    nor have they sought the Lord Almighty.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne

content:
the elders and dignitaries are the head,
    the prophets who teach lies are the tail.

teaching.name: Prophecy of the child coming to David's throne
